marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 25 knots late overnight and
to northwest 30 early Friday morning. Wind diminishing to northwest 20 Friday
evening. Scattered showers changing to rain overnight then to
scattered showers Friday evening. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
rain. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early Friday morning and
to 2 to 3 near noon Friday.<br/>
